title: Gemini Earn launches
description: Gemini launched Earn as an exchange-linked crypto yield program connected to lending arrangements with Genesis Global Capital.
notes: Launch month is based on public program history.

title: Gemini Earn redemptions frozen after Genesis halt
description: Gemini paused Earn redemptions after Genesis Global Capital suspended withdrawals following the FTX collapse and broader crypto credit crisis.

title: SEC charges Gemini and Genesis over Earn program
description: The SEC charged Gemini and Genesis in connection with the unregistered offer and sale of securities through the Gemini Earn program.
notes: Regulatory action connected to Earn program structure.

title: NYDFS settlement requires customer asset return path
description: Gemini reached a settlement with the New York Department of Financial Services related to Earn and committed to return assets to Earn customers through the Genesis bankruptcy process.

title: Gemini Earn customers begin receiving in-kind distributions
description: Gemini announced that Earn users began receiving digital assets back in kind after the Genesis bankruptcy process enabled distributions.
